_about: Reply SHAPES recorded as [observed] (seen in real Apple replies) by the fork's author: opentagviewer/docs/findmy-export/04-cloudkit.md and the comments in github.com/parawanderer/FindMy.py tests/ and findmy/cloudkit/proto/cloudkit.proto. Every VALUE here is synthetic (no real id, token, key or URL of anyone's account); only the shape (which keys/fields arrive, their types, what co-occurs) is observed. They show what the fork saw, not that Apple still answers this way.

ck_app_init._source: 04-cloudkit.md section 2.3 [observed]: eleven keys; cloudKitUserId is 33 characters; each service twice (plain p<N>- partition host, and the gateway form); metrics unpartitioned; 'values' present. The gateway URLs below are rewritten to the test server by the test.

zone_retrieve._source: 04-cloudkit.md section 3.2.3 [observed]: two zones; BeaconStore has protectionInfo, no recordProtectionInfo, deviceCount 10 and a continuation token; _defaultZone has none of them.

record_sync._source: 04-cloudkit.md section 3.5 [observed]: fields 4 (status) and 12 (zoneAttributesChanges, ~900 bytes, first page only) arrive in practice; status 3 = fully synced and can arrive on a page that still carries changes. proto comment: fields 3..8 and 12 'arrive on every page'.

record_fields._source: 04-cloudkit.md section 3.6 [observed]: every BeaconStore field had is_encrypted set while declaring the plaintext type: 3, 7, 2, 8, 15, 20.

bad_syntax._source: 04-cloudkit.md section 3.3 [observed]: omitting deviceHardwareID is rejected with a FAILURE result, client error BAD_SYNTAX (4), an errorDescription naming the field and an eight-character errorKey.

empty_500._source: 04-cloudkit.md section 3.2 [observed]: a request that does not parse (e.g. Operation.type at field 1) is answered HTTP 500 with an empty body.

error_wrappers._source: 04-cloudkit.md section 3.2.2 [observed]: clientError/serverError are wrapper messages (field 1 holds the code); declaring them as ints fails with 'invalid wire type'. Encoded here: Result{code 3, error{clientError{code 6}, retryAfterSeconds 30}}.
